:::{#exr-complement-null-space-practice}
#### Finding the orthogonal complement of a column space

@thm-complement-null-space turns the [orthogonal complement](#def-orthogonal-complement)
of a [column space](linear-algebra-rank-nullity.qmd#def-column-space) into a [null space](linear-algebra-rank-nullity.qmd#def-null-space),
which a [linear system](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-linear-system) describes.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 1}.
$$

Find $\mathcal{C}(\matr{A})^\perp$ as a [span](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-span).

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Solve $\tp{\matr{A}}\vecf{y} = \vzero_2$.

:::

:::
